brief:
Gaza's health ministry reported eight deaths and 31 injuries brought to hospitals across the territory over the past 24 hours, Shehab Wire reported. The ministry said additional casualties remain trapped under rubble and scattered on streets, though emergency and civil defense teams have been unable to reach them.

The incomplete accounting underscores the challenges facing rescue operations in Gaza. Health officials did not specify the cause of the deaths and injuries or provide details on the locations where casualties were reported during the period.
